preconditions.description: Both strings a and b must be non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in a) and all(c in '01' for c in b)
preconditions.description: Both strings a and b must consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
The lengths of both strings a and b must not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if a == b else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If a is equal to b, output 'YES'; otherwise, output 'NO'.
